|lore=Commissioned by a group of Gand venture capitalists headed by Zuckuss. Manufactured by Byblos Drive Yards. Uses repulsorlift technology developed for combat cloud cars.
|game_text=May add 2 alien pilots and 3 passengers. Zuckuss deploys free aboard. While Zuckuss piloting, opponent’s weapon, battle, and asteroid destiny draws here are -2. Immune to attrition < 3.

|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Mist Hunter (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Mist Hunter (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The remastered slip changes the opposing destiny penalty from 3 to 2 and prints attrition immunity below 3 without the Zuckuss condition. It omits the ship-docking clause, keeping the capacity, free deployment and ability to reduce opposing weapon, battle and asteroid destiny while Zuckuss pilots. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=85 Period ship-docking capability].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 4, slip 44. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Mist Hunter]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time#Cards|Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
* Earlier versions: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf first release sheet of 30 May 2003] and [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf revised sheet labeled 19 June 2003] (old pre-Remaster slips). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].
